new:
The added IID S-DFA scene favors Full in mean ACC, AEOD and ASPD in every fixed 10/9/6-seed panel and each of the three prediction views. For ten seeds, native/shared paired differences (minus_F−Full, mean±sample SD) are ACC −0.277±1.091 percentage points, AEOD +0.00284±0.00705 and ASPD +0.00564±0.01932. These directions support retaining F in this tested scene, while the Benign, F Flip and FedSA trade-offs above remain. They establish neither a significant effect nor universal necessity; native/shared outputs are identical here, and no cross-scene F aggregate is reported.

Correlated scores, compensation by candidate selection and root-estimation variability are plausible explanations, not isolated causes.

old: Constant-prediction search outcomes remain in the evidence record; zero disparity alone is not useful prediction or evidence of superiority. LoGoFair uses
new:
The completed validation-only Fed-NGA/Huber search contains 64 strictly accepted and independently checked saved-model runs: eight configurations per method, each evaluated for 70 rounds under IID/non-IID Benign and S-DFA with shared seed91001. Thus each candidate–condition has one model seed. Huber and Fed-NGA produce constant-negative predictions in 27/32 and 12/32 runs, respectively. These outcomes expose poor predictive performance in the tested CNN adaptations; zero AEOD/ASPD from constant predictions is not a fairness win. All such results remain in the record. This bounded search does not establish general failure of either original algorithm or supply across-seed SD or significance. Source freezing for 192 additional runs is distinct from completed fixed-recipe coverage; those future results are not included here.
